name: Normalized Attention Guidance (core DiT form)
plain: Applies a negative prompt inside attention rather than at the end, so it can work on models run at cfg 1. Core reads both cond and uncond tokens at each self-attention output, extrapolates, caps the L1 norm ratio, blends, and overwrites. Because it needs both in the same batch, it disables the cfg 1 skip.
math:
z̃ = z₊·φ − z₋·(φ−1)
r = max(‖z̃‖₁,1e-6) / max(‖z₊‖₁,1e-6), norm over last dim
ẑ = z̃·min(r,τ)/r
z = α·ẑ + (1−α)·z₊
z₊,z₋ are attention output tokens for cond/uncond. Only applied when both cond and uncond are in the batch. With img_slice both batch parts are overwritten; without it only the positive part is.

providers.author: komikndr
providers.note: Same φ form on attn1 output patch, for the Ray distributed nodes

label: from code
surprise: Core runs NAG on attn1 output with the normal negative in the batch, where the original fork family uses a separate NAG negative through cross-attention.
